declarations.docstring: The two distinguished endomorphisms generate the full algebra under consideration.
An algebra equivalence from the ambient algebra to the range subalgebra of its polynomial endomorphism action.
The underlying endomorphism of the range equivalence agrees with the associated polynomial action map.
The range of the polynomial endomorphism map is the designated operator subalgebra.
A subalgebra of linear endomorphisms of the polynomial module over a commutative ring.
